Patient: Specimen, Testcase V       DOB: 19/06/2026

Date of collection: 22 June 2026
Date of report: 01 July 2026

Clinical indication: Newborn, dysmorphic features noted on postnatal examination,
hypotonia, single palmar crease. Trisomy 21 suspected clinically.

Test performed: Peripheral blood karyotype, G-banding, 20 cells analysed.

RESULT

47,XY,+21

Interpretation: this is a male karyotype with an additional copy of chromosome 21,
consistent with the clinical suspicion of Down syndrome. Non-mosaic in the cells examined.

Parental karyotypes are not indicated for free trisomy 21. Recurrence risk counselling
should be offered through clinical genetics.

Limitations: karyotype detects numerical and large structural chromosome abnormalities
only. It does not detect submicroscopic copy number changes or sequence variants.
